trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Bilaspur in C.S. No. 452-A of 2021
case_name: Smt. Chandrani Bande vs Dr. Dilip Kumar Bande
facts_of_case: Petitioner's application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act for grant of maintenance pendente lite and expenses of proceedings was rejected by the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: The court may order the respondent to pay expenses of proceeding and monthly sum during the proceeding if it appears that either party has no independent income sufficient for their support.
legal_principles.held: Where in any proceeding under this Act it appears to the court that either the wife or the husband, as the case may be, has no independent income sufficient for her or his support...

legal_principles.principle: The court's decision to grant or reject maintenance pendente lite and expenses of proceeding depends on the parties' respective incomes.
legal_principles.held: it may seem to the court to be reasonable: having regard to the petitioner's own income and the income of the respondent...

outcome.final_order: The order passed by the Principal Judge, Family Court, Bilaspur in C.S. No. 452-A of 2021 is set aside and the application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act is allowed.
